name: MLB Booth
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Deep live MLB for the Omarchy bar. Pick any of the 30 clubs; the pill carries score, half inning, count, and outs from the same GUMBO feed MLB's own Gameday runs on. Free, keyless data from the MLB Stats API.

barWidget.description: Counts down to first pitch, then goes live: score, half inning, count, and outs, refreshed every 20 seconds. The panel adds the line score, bases, matchup, last play, the week's schedule, and the division race.
